# Logistic Lasso

```{r, warning = FALSE}
n = nrow(data)
K = 10    # 10-fold CV
Prediction_index = 4

# 설정하려는 Seed 총 개수
Seed_Num = 10

# Coefficient List
Coefficient <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)

# Parameter grid 설정
threshold_grid <- seq(from = 0, to = 1, length.out = 51)
lambda_grid <- 10^seq(2, -5, length = 70) # 10의 exponent로 grid 생성
lambda <- lambda_grid[40]  # Optimal Lambda

for(seed in 1:Seed_Num){  # Seed를 다르게 하는 For loop
  print("seed")
  print(seed)
  set.seed(seed)

      for(CV in 1:K){
        ########################################################################################
        # CV generation. Train : Test를 9:1로 나눔 (이때의 train, test는 validation approach)  #
        ########################################################################################
        CV_index <- split(sample(1:n), rep(1:K, length.out = n))
        train <- data[-CV_index[[CV]], ] # Train set
        train_index <- c(1:n) 
        train_index <- train_index[-CV_index[[CV]]] # Train set의 index (필요할 경우 사용)
        test <- data[CV_index[[CV]], ] # Test set
        test_rowNum <- nrow(test) # Test set row Numbers (필요할 경우 사용))
        
        #################################################################
        # Modeling and Prediction. Update Accuracy, FNR, FPR, F1 score  #
        #################################################################
        Model <- glmnet(as.matrix(train[, -Prediction_index]), train$target, family = "binomial", alpha = 1, lambda = lambda)
        
        Coefficient[[seed]] <- c(Coefficient[[seed]], as.matrix(coef(Model))[,1])
  
    }
}
```



# Zero or not Plot

```{r}
Zero_Coef <- function(seed){
  Coefficient_df <- as.data.frame(Coefficient[[seed]])
  Coefficient_df <- Coefficient_df%>%
    mutate(CV = (row_number() - 1)%/%56 + 1)%>%
    mutate(index = (row_number() - 1)%%56 + 1)
  
  colnames(Coefficient_df) <- c("Coef", "CV", "index")


  Zero_Coefficient <- Coefficient_df%>%
    group_by(index)%>%
    summarise(avgZero = mean(Coef == 0))

  Zero_Coefficient <- Zero_Coefficient[-1,]
  
  Zero_Coefficient <- Zero_Coefficient%>%
    mutate(column = colnames(data)[index])
  
  return(Zero_Coefficient$avgZero)
}


Zero_Coefficient <- (Zero_Coef(1) + Zero_Coef(2) + Zero_Coef(3) + Zero_Coef(4) + Zero_Coef(5) + Zero_Coef(6) + Zero_Coef(7) + Zero_Coef(8) + Zero_Coef(9) + Zero_Coef(10))/10

Zero_Coefficient <- as.data.frame(Zero_Coefficient)%>%
  mutate(column = colnames(data)[row_number()])%>%
  rename("avgZero" = "Zero_Coefficient")

Zero_Coefficient %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = column, y = avgZero))+
  geom_point(size = 0.5)+
  coord_flip()+
  ggtitle("avgZero : Lasso Coefficient average number being zero")+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    text = element_text(size = 5, face = "bold"),
  )
```
